bullets: Playing at Georgia Tech is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).

It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.
